profile.headline: Software Architect
profile.summary:
Microsoft Professional (MCP, MCAD, MCSD)

Specialties: ASP, ASP.Net, ASP.Net MVC, C#, Web Service, WCF, WPF

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
● Design and implement the key features for the Global Shopping Cart that is used across all the Lamps Plus family of sites.
● Design and implement REST based apis for converting legacy WebForms application to MVC and WebApi with richer user interaction.
● Identify and fix performance bottlenecks to handle large customer carts.
● Work with offsite team members, perform code reviews, lead and mentor junior developers.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
● Design and implement features for Lamps Plus family of web sites, Implement the main product detail page, landing pages.
● Key contributor for a new Flash Sale site 55downingStreet.com
● Key contributor for www.qtee.com a site to sell customizable apparel fully implemented using MVC, WebApi and Single Page Application (SPA) features.
● Serve as a Tech lead for various projects and site releases.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Convert Asp.Net 3.5 client site to MVC site using the razor view engine
● Created tools using AJAX to dynamically create, edit object so client can create, resize, delete objects in individual sales label.
● Manage 3 SQL 2008 databases, backup, synchronize data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Push e-commerce web changes to staging and live site on demand.
● Create web promotions, contests, weekly winner drawings.
● Convert ASP.Net 3.5 site to MVC.
● Manage SQL databases and IIS..

positions.title: Software Engineer (Contractor)
positions.description:
● Design and create e-commerce website using ASP.Net 3.5 and MVC
● Create google map store locator using AJAX feature

positions.title: Software Engineer (Contractor)
positions.description:
● Create and Manage ASP.Net web sites using .Net framework 1.1 and 2.0
● Manage clients daily processes that require data processing, pdf generation

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
● Build template based web application using custom culture, AJAX, XMLHTTPRequest.
● Create business logic for complicated medical cost calculation and preference logic.
● Led a team of 3 developers to create an Admin-Tool to manage current application's setting, resource and functionality.
● Use TFS to manage Work Items, bug fix, QA testing and push data for QA, Staging and Production environments.
● SaaS type of application to support different clients including Cigna, Aetna, Wellpoint, Health Spring, AVMed and many more.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Design and develop various applications for America Honda Motors..
● Design web application “AOMS (Auto Order Management System),” helping users keep track of auto parts relocation in real time.
● Design and maintain web application “DDMS Candidate.” help qualified candidates fill-out applications for auto dealership
● Develop a web application “NARS (North America Reporting System).” for helping headquarters to communicate with the part-center using the application in real time.

positions.title: C# Windows Application Developer
positions.description:
● Design and develop C# 1.0 (later migrate project to 2.0) Windows application created to manage transactions between client and various departments (customer service, billing, dispatching, warehouse).
● Implement company web site (www.e3pl.com) using ASP and SQL 2000.
● Manage and maintain sister company website (www.gold-point.com, www.harbor-express.com)

positions.title: Windows and Web Application Developer
positions.description:
● Design and implement most of the front and back end of the HR Department’s intranet application to help store managers and HR personnel track employee’s data,
● Implement windows “Time Clock” an application used for calculating employees work time and salary using each person’s fingerprint, recognizing specific employees, and calculate their time and salary. The application was designed to handle data from over 150 stores in US and Canada.
● Manage massive store sales transactions, online transactions, and gift cards for each store’s POS System using SQL 2000.
● Maintain Forever21.com web site using MS Commerce 2002, SQL 2000.
